component.name: Nitor
component.summary: Control NZXT LED lighting without NZXT CAM

description.p: Nitor controls the RGB and LED lighting of supported NZXT controllers on Linux: it can set a colour, choose an effect from the ones the hardware actually supports, and pick which LED channel to drive.

It is deliberately small. Nitor only ever sets LED colours, and it never changes pump speed, fan speed, cooling curves, thermal thresholds or firmware. Those commands are refused in code rather than merely being left out of the interface.
Nitor talks to the hardware through liquidctl, which provides the safe, documented protocol support and the udev rules that allow unprivileged access to the devices.

First development release: detects supported NZXT controllers, sets colours and effects on the LED channels the hardware reports, keeps settings in the standard XDG locations, and can reapply them at login through a systemd user service.
